UserPromptSubmit.name: session-start-status
UserPromptSubmit.description: Display project health and status at session start
UserPromptSubmit.prompt:
Provide a quick project status overview:

1. Git status (branch, uncommitted changes)
2. Docker containers status (if backend is running)
3. Recent errors in logs (if any)
4. Quick health check summary

Be concise (3-5 lines max). Only show if relevant to current work.

PostToolUse.name: auto-lint-javascript
PostToolUse.description: Run ESLint on edited JavaScript/JSX files
PostToolUse.command: cd frontend && npm run lint --fix {{file_path}} 2>&1 || true

PostToolUse.name: auto-format-check
PostToolUse.description: Remind to check formatting after multiple edits
PostToolUse.prompt:
You've made several edits recently. Consider running code formatting:
- Frontend: npm run lint:fix
- Check for any console warnings

Only mention this if you haven't already suggested it.

PostToolUse.name: git-status-reminder
PostToolUse.description: Remind to check git status after significant file creation
PostToolUse.prompt:
You've created several new files. Consider checking git status to ensure they're tracked:
  git status

Only mention if relevant and not already discussed.
